verdict.rationale: doola documents a Partner API for creating customers, submitting formations, retrieving documents, reference-data lookups and annual-report filing. The docs also cover API keys, idempotent retries, machine-readable error codes, signed webhooks, a sandbox environment and an llms.txt index, which together let an agent drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe got 404 on every candidate path), independent hands-on corroboration, and clarity on whether access is public or partner-gated (keys come from the Partner Portal).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The doola Partner API lets you create customers, submit company formations (LLC or C-Corp), retrieve formation documents, and look up reference data.
Every error carries a machine readable code, so you can branch on it without parsing strings.
Retrying with the same key and the same body returns the original result and never creates a duplicate.
signed-in Partner Portal users create, revoke and delete keys themselves, and you can hold several at once.
Read what a state asks and charges, put a company's annual report on file, confirm it, and follow it to completion.
